What release of KiwiDesk is currently su: The current supported release is KiwiDesk 4.2.
What does Smart Inbox route by?: The Smart Inbox feature routes incoming customer messages by urgency, account tier, and language.
What should I check for KD-401?: If document upload fails with error KD-401, check that the account has document indexing enabled.
What is the default upload size limit?: The maximum supported local upload size in the default configuration is 20 MB.
What should I confirm when search return: If search returns no answers, first confirm that at least one document has status indexed.
What is the KiwiDesk API base path?: The fictional KiwiDesk API base path is `/api/v2`.
Which field is returned when creating a: The `POST /api/v2/tickets` endpoint creates a ticket and returns the identifier field `ticket_id`.
What query parameter does the search end: The `GET /api/v2/search` endpoint accepts the query parameter `q` and an optional `limit` parameter.
Which workspace header should API client: API clients should send the `X-KiwiDesk-Workspace` header with each request.
What did KiwiDesk 4.2 add?: KiwiDesk 4.2 added Smart Inbox language routing and improved JSON export reliability.
What did KiwiDesk 4.1 introduce?: KiwiDesk 4.1 introduced CSV export for ticket analytics.
Is version 4.2 backward compatible with: Version 4.2 remains backward compatible with integrations built for version 4.1.
How should document access be scoped?: KiwiDesk requires document access to be scoped by user ownership.
How must passwords be stored?: Passwords must be stored as salted hashes and must never be logged.
Can uploaded document instructions overr: Instructions inside uploaded documents must not override application or system instructions.
